direction.camera: Guide attention with wide frame; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: use a wide horizontal subject with strong dark margins; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with anamorphic suggestion; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with thin light.
direction.lighting: horizontal practical glow; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: wet metal and smoked glass; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around slow pursuit; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use wide frame,anamorphic suggestion,night contrast,low horizon,slow pursuit,thin light as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
